job.title: Business Development and Strategic Relationships Manager
job.description:
Senior Strategic Growth Role | Electrical, Utilities & Infrastructure

Are you a well-connected commercial leader ready for a new challenge?

We are seeking an accomplished Business Development & Strategic Relationships Manager to play a pivotal role in the next phase of growth for an established business operating across the electrical, utilities, infrastructure and industrial services sectors.

This is not simply a role focused on chasing the next opportunity. We are looking for someone who can take the business to the next level – strengthening our market position, opening new doors, developing high-value strategic relationships and helping shape where the business goes next.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join a business with strong capability and significant growth potential and make a genuine impact.

The Opportunity

Working closely with senior leadership, you will take ownership of business development and strategic relationship activity across the Australian market.

You will leverage your existing industry network while continuing to build relationships with key clients, market partners and industry stakeholders. Your focus will be on identifying the right opportunities, understanding where the market is heading and converting relationships and market intelligence into sustainable commercial growth.

The market is evolving rapidly, with significant investment across data centres, batteries, grid resilience, transmission infrastructure and renewable energy creating exciting opportunities for future growth.

You will have the autonomy and senior-level exposure to help determine where the business should focus, which opportunities should be pursued and how the organisation can continue to strengthen its position in the market.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will develop and execute a targeted business development strategy, build and manage a strong forward pipeline and identify commercially attractive opportunities across existing and emerging markets.

A major part of your role will be building trusted relationships with senior clients and industry stakeholders, gaining early visibility of upcoming projects, investment priorities and future programs, and positioning the business as a long-term strategic partner rather than simply a service provider.

You will also work closely with technical, operational, estimating and project teams to turn customer requirements into commercially viable solutions, while contributing to major bids, proposals, pricing strategies and commercial negotiations.

Importantly, you will bring intelligence back into the business – identifying market trends, competitor activity, strategic partnerships and emerging opportunities that can inform the organisation’s broader growth strategy.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone with 7+ years’ experience across business development, strategic account management, market development, client relationship management or commercial growth.

You will ideally bring experience within the electrical, utilities, infrastructure or industrial services sectors, along with a strong understanding of how to identify, shape and convert complex commercial opportunities.

Most importantly, you will be well connected.

You know the market. You have established senior-level relationships and credibility within your industry. You understand how to open doors, develop trust and turn conversations into long-term commercial partnerships.

You will be commercially astute, strategic and comfortable operating with senior decision-makers. You can see both the immediate opportunity and the bigger picture – balancing revenue growth with margin, risk, strategic value and the organisation’s ability to deliver.

Why Join?This is an opportunity for someone who has built a successful career in business development and is now looking for a role where they can have greater influence, ownership and impact.

You won’t simply inherit a sales target and be told to go and sell. You will have the opportunity to help shape the growth strategy, build strategic partnerships, develop new markets and work alongside senior leadership to determine where the business goes next.

We want someone who is excited by the prospect of growing with the business and helping take it to the next level.

If you are well connected, commercially driven and ready for your next challenge, we would like to hear from you.

Understand the market. Build the relationships. Shape the opportunity. Win the right work.

Apply now and contact Kellie May 03 9535 2111

Employment Type: Three Month Temp assignment | 5 days a week
Working arrangement: Work across standard business hours

Our client is a leading global manufacturing organisation. Due to continued growth and an expanding product portfolio, they require a Logistics Coordinator to join their team on a temporary basis.
This is a hands-on operational role suited to someone who enjoys working autonomously, coordinating multiple logistics activities and ensuring the smooth movement of inventory from import through to final customer delivery.
You will work closely with internal teams and external logistics providers to coordinate imports, inventory, outbound deliveries, returns and general logistics administration.

  • Benefit from a strong focus on employee wellbeing and work-life balance
  • Enjoy a collaborative and inclusive working environment
  • Autonomous role with varied day-to-day responsibilities

Reporting to the Australian Distribution Manager, your responsibilities will include:

Imports
  • Monitor incoming containers arriving from overseas
  • Maintain and update container ETAs in relevant systems
  • Coordinate and schedule unloading activities with logistics service providers
  • Register shipping documentation for import customs clearance
  • Monitor fumigation and customs clearance processes
Inventory
  • Coordinate workshop transfers in collaboration with warehouse and customer service teams
  • Create product labels for repackaged units
  • Support rework activities
  • Monitor stock levels, movements and inventory variances
  • Assist with general stock reconciliation across the warehouse network
Outbound Deliveries

  • Investigate and process daily delivery exceptions

  • Retrieve proof of delivery (POD) documentation

Returns
  • Process customer claims and return requests
  • Coordinate return requests from Order Management teams across D2C, Projects and Retail
  • Process manual refunds for exchanges through Power Apps
Administration & Invoicing
  • Conduct daily checks to ensure correct use of shipping conditions
  • Monitor and investigate failed deliveries
  • Apply additional services in the system prior to invoice reconciliation
  • Generate regular logistics reports
  • Provide general administrative support to the Logistics team
 
About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
  • Previous experience in a Logistics Coordinator, Logistics Administrator, Supply Chain Coordinator or similar role
  • Experience coordinating freight, deliveries, inventory or warehouse activities
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and confidence liaising with internal teams, customers and external logistics providers
  • Experience working with logistics, inventory or ERP systems
  • A proactive and autonomous approach to your work

Experience with imports, customs documentation, warehouse transfers, returns or transport coordination will be highly regarded.

The Senior HR Coordinator supports the full employee lifecycle for approximately 150 staff across VIC, SA and TAS. Reporting to the CEO, the role is the main point of contact for day-to-day people matters across the business. Key responsibilities include:
 
  • Recruitment, onboarding & offboarding - Run end-to-end hiring for operational to admin roles. You will prepare offers, contracts and checks and ensure smooth onboarding, managing probation and exits.

  • Safety, wellbeing & culture - Support RTW / workers comp admin and coordinate engagement activity for internal comms and events.
  • Continuous improvement - Ensure best practice for HR processes, maintaining policies and review dates.

You will have strong HR coordination / advisory experience, ideally in manufacturing, construction, trades or field services, including end-to-end recruitment for blue-collar and admin roles and working knowledge of Fair Work, NES and modern awards.
 
With an HR qualification (or equivalent) you will also bring hands-on experience with Employment Hero or similar for administration and ability to demonstrate capability. job.title: Product Management and PLM Enablement Lead
job.description:
The Company
 
A growing business, this ISO accredited company manufactures and supplies a wide range of high-quality engineered industrial products to a variety of industries for use in the industrial, infrastructure and domestic markets. With an ever-expanding footprint, to support the company’s growth, they are in the market to appoint an experienced Product Management and PLM Lead.
 
 
The Role
 
As the subject matter expert in product management, the role exists to build the capability of the Product Managers across the full Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) process, from opportunity assessment and discovery, through product launch, into performance management, improvement and, ultimately, retirement. Key Responsibilities include:
 
Capability Development
  • Design and deliver a structured Product Management curriculum across the full PLM lifecycle
  • Facilitate workshops, coaching, onboarding, and refresher training
  • Develop practical learning resources, templates, and product-based case studies
 
Product Management Coaching
  • Mentor Product Managers through discovery, business cases, roadmaps, and product launches
  • Provide coaching, peer reviews, and constructive feedback to strengthen capability
  • Support Product Managers through key lifecycle gates as a trusted advisor
 
PLM Tools & Standards
  • Develop and maintain PLM playbooks, templates, checklists, and business case frameworks
  • Establish consistent product management standards, governance processes, and quality benchmarks
  • Maintain a central library of PLM resources and best practices
 
Continuous Improvement
  • Lead the Product Management Community of Practice to encourage knowledge sharing and collaboration
  • Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into PLM frameworks and tools
  • Benchmark industry best practices to continuously enhance Product Management capability and processes
 
 
The Person
 
You will have extensive product management experience across the full product lifecycle, in addition to expertise in launching and managing physical, engineered or manufactured products, developing product management capability through coaching and mentoring, and creating practical PLM frameworks, tools, and standards.
 
With a tertiary qualification in business, engineering, marketing, or a related discipline. An MBA and recognised product management certification are desirable. You will also have strong commercial acumen and knowledge of product strategy, market analysis, business cases, and go-to-market planning.

job.title: Service Technician Supervisor
job.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
Our client is an established Australian provider of critical engineered equipment and technical field support services, working across commercial and industrial customer sites. The business has a strong focus on safe work practices, high service standards, and developing skilled technicians through training and ongoing support.

ABOUT THE ROLE
This position leads the day-to-day coordination and performance of a field-based service team delivering installation, servicing, repairs, and urgent response work across customer locations. Reporting into the Service Manager, you’ll be the escalation point for complex technical issues and customer concerns, while keeping scheduling, documentation, and team standards running smoothly in a high-pressure environment.

DUTIES
• Lead, coach and hold standards for a field service team (including contractors as required), building trust and capability through regular check-ins, on-the-job guidance, performance management, and ensuring the team consistently represents the business professionally on customer sites
• Own job allocation end-to-end: plan the weekly workload, triage urgent callouts, reshuffle schedules in real time when conditions change, and maintain clear communication with technicians, admin and customers so expectations are set and met under tight timeframes
• Be the senior point of support for technical problem solving and customer escalations: assist with diagnosis and decision-making when jobs become complex, attend critical works when needed, and drive practical outcomes that protect service quality and customer relationships
• Drive safe delivery and compliance discipline across all works: reinforce PPE and site safety behaviour, ensure risk controls and required paperwork are completed correctly (pre-starts, job safety documentation, service records), and support incident/quality investigations and corrective actions where required
• Lift operational performance: monitor productivity and utilisation, identify recurring issues and bottlenecks, coordinate parts/tools/vehicles so work can be executed efficiently, and improve reporting accuracy and workflow discipline to strengthen customer outcomes and reduce rework

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• Proven experience leading a trade / technical / service team in a customer-facing, field-based environment where priorities shift quickly; you’re confident balancing multiple moving jobs and keeping people aligned when pressure is high
• Strong coordination and communication capability (written + verbal): you can run a busy schedule, provide clear direction, keep stakeholders updated, and ensure technicians complete accurate job notes and reporting without constant chasing
• High mechanical aptitude is essential (trade qualification preferred but not mandatory if the hands-on technical understanding is there); you can guide fault-finding and support technicians during difficult situations
• Calm, resilient, and emotionally switched-on leadership style: you can have professional, direct conversations with technicians and customers during escalations, show empathy without losing standards
• Comfortable with a role that includes both office-based coordination and time in the field (often on customer sites), plus occasional after-hours contact for true emergencies, this suits someone who enjoys responsibility, variety, and being the person others rely on to stabilise the day

BENEFITS
• Competitive salary package + fully maintained tool of trade vehicle
• Autonomous leadership role with real impact across service delivery, customer outcomes, and technician performance
• Strong internal support from the service leadership team and access to training for technical and safety capability uplift
• Stable, long-term opportunity within a business investing in service standards and team development
